name: CallRail
description: CallRail is a call tracking and conversation intelligence platform that attributes inbound phone calls, web forms, and text messages directly to marketing campaigns and keywords.
best_for: Marketing agencies, local service businesses, and healthcare/legal practices that rely heavily on inbound phone leads.
features: Dynamic Number Insertion (DNI) to track calls down to PPC keyword and ad campaign
Form tracking to capture website form submissions alongside phone call data
AI conversation intelligence with automatic call transcription and sentiment analysis
Lead center with softphone calling, SMS text messaging, and live call routing
Deep integrations with Google Ads, GA4, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Zapier
Multi-account agency dashboard with white-label client reporting

tiers.name: Lead Tracking
tiers.notes: Plus additional usage. Includes 5 local numbers and 250 local minutes a month.

tiers.name: Lead Tracking Complete
tiers.notes: Plus additional usage. Adds form tracking and attribution.

tiers.name: Lead Conversion
tiers.notes: Plus additional usage. Adds Premium Conversation Intelligence.

tiers.name: Lead Conversion Complete
tiers.notes: Plus additional usage. Includes form tracking and attribution and Premium Conversation Intelligence.

pros: High accuracy dynamic number insertion and marketing call attribution
Powerful AI call transcripts and automated lead qualification summaries
Flawless native data sync to Google Ads for offline conversion tracking
cons: Usage overages apply when exceeding monthly minute or phone number thresholds
Conversation intelligence is only on the two Lead Conversion plans, which start at $150 a month compared with $50 for Lead Tracking
Prices are listed per month plus additional usage; the page shows a yearly saving of up to 10% but no yearly prices

alternatives.best_for: Agencies needing multi-client lead valuation and proof of marketing ROI
strengths: Calls, forms, chats in one place
